artifacts.name: agent-guidelines
artifacts.description: Agent guidelines — project overview, TDD methodology, environment/tooling, the six-layer clearinghouse layout (framework / domain-legislative / usa-wa-common vocabulary / adapters / facts / deployment) enforced by import-linter, per-package module map, infrastructure and systemd topology, DB role split, env vars, commit and logging conventions, and the code exploration policy. Source of truth for how the repo is organized.

artifacts.name: architecture-pattern
artifacts.description: The reusable Layer-3 sourcing pattern — sourcing vs. application, multi-source target packages, Phase A (an adapter's raw_harvest into the raw store) vs. Phase B (the pipeline's dbt models over the adapter's pure parsers), a worked example traced end to end, and the binding rules: audit a source's coverage before building on it, never key a parser on an exact upstream string, one writer per published dataset. Read before adding an adapter, a data source, or a span/seat builder.

artifacts.name: ontology
artifacts.description: The domain model — what ingested data becomes: entities, lifecycle axes, spans-as-assignments, and the three event shapes. Sibling of ARCHITECTURE.md (which covers how data gets in). Read before adding a fact.

artifacts.name: architecture-specs
artifacts.description: Architecture specs — jurisdiction decoupling, identity sync, Power Map sync sidecar, WSL SOAP transformation, committee historical backfill, merge-orphan self-heal, subscription sync, and more. Source of truth for design decisions per subsystem.

artifacts.name: design-plans
artifacts.description: Per-phase implementation plans — foundation/discovery, hybrid legislative IA, jurisdiction decoupling, sync sidecar, outbox dead-letter, entity-event wiring, WSL adapter phases, and later backlog. Historical record of how each phase was built.

artifacts.name: integration-contracts
artifacts.description: Discovery outputs and integration contracts — Archiver/Watcher/Power Map contracts, multi-state legislative IA delta, jurisdictional information architecture, and Power Map reseed guidance, and the #135 biennium-rollover rehearsal record (what the nightly does when 2027-28 becomes current; when WSL, PDC and SOS start answering for the new cycle).

artifacts.name: modules-framework
artifacts.description: Layers 1-2 module reference — the jurisdiction-agnostic framework primitives in clearinghouse-core (raw store, job harness, identity registry, sources and their coverage claims, jurisdictions) and the legislative domain in clearinghouse-domain-legislative (term calendar, span engine, operator overlay and its attestation models).

artifacts.name: modules-common
artifacts.description: Layer 2b usa-wa-common module reference — Washington vocabulary (term calendar, seats, name handling, parties, ballot shapes, the jurisdiction vocabulary and its seeder). Source-free: may not import an adapter.

artifacts.name: modules-legislature
artifacts.description: WSL (Washington State Legislature) adapter module reference — SOAP transport, the raw harvest, resource ids, pure parsers and projectors the pipeline stages through, provisioning/coverage claims, and write-free probes.

artifacts.name: modules-legislature-roster
artifacts.description: The roster-PDF source (1889-2025 official member roster) — transport, edition stamp check, raw harvest, parser, audit oracle, and the succession/resolve helpers.

artifacts.name: modules-legislature-roster-build
artifacts.description: The roster PDF's #228 pre-1991 build modules — identity fold, party-change annotations, the observation projector, Person minting and retirement, minted-member emission, the sponsor-build deepening input, and the Phase B builder CLI.

artifacts.name: modules-legislature-spans
artifacts.description: The tenure-span subject area across two layers — the Layer-2 engine (biennium arithmetic, merged-span builder, operator succession overlay) and the Layer-3 WSL side (operator-event and committee-succession stores and CLIs, roster hygiene, the span projectors the pipeline's conformed models use).

artifacts.name: modules-pdc
artifacts.description: PDC (Public Disclosure Commission) SODA adapter module reference — transport, resource ids, the raw harvest of winner cohorts, provisioning/coverage, and the positions parser.

artifacts.name: modules-sos
artifacts.description: Washington Secretary of State adapter module reference — the filings and election-results sources.

artifacts.name: modules-facts-seats
artifacts.description: Layer 3b usa-wa-facts-seats module reference — the pure seat-fact logic the pipeline composes across sources: House Position matching, back-chaining and projection, PDC observations.

artifacts.name: modules-deployment
artifacts.description: Layer 4 module reference — the usa-wa-api deployment and the repo-root directories.

artifacts.name: commands
artifacts.description: Command index plus setup, tests and migrations — the entry point to the grouped operational command references.

artifacts.name: commands-succession
artifacts.description: Operator attestation commands — succession events and committee lineage links, recorded to the registry and archived to the raw store; the nightly pipeline applies them.

artifacts.name: commands-backfill
artifacts.description: The write-free WSL probes (committee/meeting extent, member-Id stability). The roster PDF is in COMMANDS-ROSTER.md.

artifacts.name: commands-roster
artifacts.description: Roster PDF commands — the raw harvest of an edition and its monthly dry-run edition re-check (#225/#237/#421) with the alert runbook.

artifacts.name: socraticode-doc
artifacts.description: Code exploration tool selection — the generated goal→tool table, prefetch, per-tool notes, graph-health and index-scope guidance (init-socraticode template, between the socraticode-doc markers), plus this repo's own notes below the END marker: the measurements behind the file-dependency graph's repair in SocratiCode 1.13.0 (13 → 1,633 edges, grep-verified) and the engine version floor that remains the one caveat; the background-work trap (graph builds, indexes and watcher updates run inside the server process after the tool call returns, so killing it persists half-finished state silently — check Last built and indexingStatus, not the headline count); the manifest-coverage drift check (#300); and why the server is pinned rather than installed per launch (#389).

artifacts.name: api
artifacts.description: The HTTP API — the read-only /api/v1 surface: route inventory, pagination, and the response contracts.

artifacts.name: deployment
artifacts.description: Deployment reference — systemd unit table, the OnFailure alerting chain, the owner/app/test DB role split, the never-sync-the-venv convention, the restart and lifecycle table, and the verify-units gate.

artifacts.name: deployment-host
artifacts.description: Host hazards that break correct units — the assert-main-checkout gate that keeps the prod checkout on main (#87), the shared-venv integrity guard (#279), memory-pressure protection (MemoryLow, OOMScoreAdjust, earlyoom, #389), and the disk GC + slim ollama image host-maintenance commands (#394).

artifacts.name: runbook-rollover
artifacts.description: Biennium-rollover runbook (#135, Nov 2026 to Feb 2027): what runs on its own (early capture from 2026-11-04, the daily WSL availability probe), the 2026-11-04 checklist, the exact nightly email expected from 2027-01-01 (WSL harvest degraded on GetCommittees' fault + assignments_chamber_vacancy) and the data state that is correct that night, what happens as WSL publishes sponsors then committees (House seats need the 2026 ballot), and the manual steps.

artifacts.name: recovery
artifacts.description: Backup and recovery runbook (#434): what in Postgres and on disk cannot be rebuilt (the registry, the raw store) and what can; the nightly create-only backup to gs://co-gcs-usa-wa-backup (db/<host>/<stamp>.dump + the raw-store mirror under raw/), its sandbox (dynamic user, peer-auth pg_read_all_data role, key as a systemd credential, guards via GIT_CONFIG safe.directory, .env masked), GCP provisioning for the project owner, install and the create-only probe, the restore (list / fetch + prove / load into an empty database + identity checks / --raw-into) and the replacement-host order, and the rehearsal log.

artifacts.name: environment
artifacts.description: Every environment variable the deployment reads, with defaults, including the Power Map sidecar tunables.

artifacts.name: logging
artifacts.description: The JSON log record shape ({timestamp, level, logger, message}, four reserved keys) and why every uvicorn invocation must pass --log-config or journald interleaves plain-text access lines with JSON app records.

artifacts.name: skills
artifacts.description: Vendored agent skills — inventory, the submodule and symlink layout under skills/ and .claude/skills/, the refresh procedure, worktree venv isolation, the context budget, and the ship gate's sensitive-path list.

artifacts.name: readme
artifacts.description: Repository orientation — setup, the dev-server and port convention, the operational CLI list, and curated links into the canonical docs. The human entry point; AGENTS.md is the agent one.

artifacts.name: pipeline-reference
artifacts.description: The #302 dataset-publication pipeline — dbt-duckdb project layout, commands, the raw file store (objects/manifests/latest.json), the staging models, the identity registry and registrar, and the gates over conformed assignments (seat occupancy #359/#360/#363 and the checks ported from the retired canonical tier, #412). The conformed tier lives in PIPELINE-CONFORMED.md; the publication contract in PIPELINE-PUBLICATION.md.

artifacts.name: pipeline-conformed
artifacts.description: The #302 pipeline's conformed tier — the tenure-span engine (two families, one table, the #228 roster deepening and its refusals), the structurally keyed roles dimension, and the citations chain (per-kind rules, the coverage probe, its zero gates and the uncited-persons ratchet).

artifacts.name: pipeline-conformed-entities
artifacts.description: The conformed tier's identity surface — person/org crosswalks read from the identity registry, and the persons/organizations entities with their survivorship rules and guards.

artifacts.name: pipeline-publication
artifacts.description: The publication contract a subscriber (power-map) builds against — the immutable versioned dataset tree, catalog.json and its fields, the publisher's gates and the nightly chain, the staging/conformed/internal tiers, per-dataset schema versions and contract_hash (#385), the catalog heartbeat checked_at + its stale_after deadline and what it does and does not cover (#386), and the declared CSV dialect (#357).
